## Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g. "I cannot perform flexural toppling checks with layer spacing...")

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Geotechnical & Mathematical Basis

- **Standard / Reference Literature:** (e.g. Markland 1972, Hoek & Bray 1981, Goodman 1989)
- **Input Parameters Needed:** (e.g. joint spacing, water pressure, cohesion)
- **Equations / Algorithms:** Summary of mathematical derivations or bounding inequalities.

## Architectural Layer Impact

- [ ] `@geokinematics/domain` (domain types and orientation interfaces)
- [ ] `@geokinematics/geometry` (pure coordinate/stereonet geometry)
- [ ] `@geokinematics/kinematics` (kinematic admissibility analysis)
- [ ] `@geokinematics/ui` (interactive stereonet/controls UI components)
- [ ] `geokinematics-core` (Rust / WebAssembly computational engine)
- [ ] `apps/web` (Next.js application & workspace)

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, diagrams, or references here.
